direction: Existing deterministic production direction engine; no score fitting
entry: Existing FAST acceptance or fresh retest confirmation; native data and executable cost gate required
levels: Fixed local 5m/15m common-anchor band; observed all-timeframe obstacles; frozen stop and target
paper_entry: Next full 1m open after TRIGGERED; recheck original stop, target, room and net R
paper_exit: First stop or TP1; otherwise 180 minutes; stop-first ambiguous minute; gap stop uses open
cost_model: Signal book cost proxy plus verified historical funding, not actual fills
measurement_unit: First retained geometry log per symbol/direction/UTC 5m bucket; descriptive scans, not independent trades
direction_join: Unique preceding same-symbol direction log within 1 second; ambiguity/missing stays unknown
primary_performance: Independent paper ledger grouped by source/locked-plan/geometry cohort; no gross direction proxy promoted to PnL
freeze: No entry/exit/score/threshold changes as part of this audit; code hash must match before grouping results
limitations: No profitability claim or optimized hit-rate target
No market-wide recall estimate from selected deep-analysis logs
Ablation payloads currently compare direction decisions only, not net trade returns
No entry delay estimate when no TRIGGERED events exist
Rejected-candidate next-minute counterfactuals are not executable missed trades
Snapshot covers a short window and may contain correlated repeated symbols
